speaker: Doctor
text:
Since you have no constitutional symptoms like fever or weight loss, and your ABG confirms significant hypoxemia, is there any history of smoking, exposure to dust or chemicals, or a previous diagnosis of heart disease?

speaker: Doctor
text:
Since your echocardiogram is normal, we can rule out heart failure as the cause of your hypoxemia. Have you noticed any chest pain, palpitations, or swelling in your legs?

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: CT_Chest: Bilateral ground-glass opacities and reticular interstitial thickening consistent with pulmonary fibrosis. No evidence of pleural effusion, lymphadenopathy, or acute consolidation.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis (IPF). The clinical picture of a six-week history of progressive dyspnea, non-productive cough, absence of constitutional symptoms or cardiac disease, and CT findings of bilateral ground-glass opacities with reticular interstitial thickening strongly supports this diagnosis. I recommend a referral for pulmonary function tests and high-resolution CT review to confirm the diagnosis and assess disease severity.

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) with possible pulmonary fibrosis
